raw_annotations.proposed_function: Required for interaction with Ccr4-Not and stimulation of deadenylation activity; described as an amino-terminal low-complexity (serine-rich) region.
raw_annotations.evidence: The YTH domain of Mmi1 is preceded by an 35-kDa amino-terminal low-complexity (serine-rich) region (Figure S7A).

raw_annotations.proposed_function: Binding to Ccr4-Not complex to tether RNA-binding YTH domain
raw_annotations.evidence: Deletion of 56 N-terminal amino acids was sufficient to eliminate binding (Figure 7°C). Thus, the extreme N terminus of Mmi1 is required for interaction with Ccr4-Not.

raw_annotations.proposed_function: Targets bound RNA for deadenylation by Ccr4-Not
raw_annotations.evidence: A low-complexity N-terminal region likely targets the bound RNA for deadenylation by Ccr4-Not (Du et al., 2016).
